Suppose we choose $$\hat{	heta}=(2,1)**{T}.$$ Consider the wine 'Billywine' with hue $$ rac{1}{4}$$ and abv $$-2.$$
Suppose that we choose a threshold $$T$$ such that the decision boundary of our model is
$$2\cdot	ext{hue}+	ext{abv}= rac{3}{2}$$
What value of $$T$$ results in this decision boundary? There is only one correct answer. $$( eta$$ and $$\gamma$$ are as defined in the previous two subparts.)
